description: Overwrite properties of an existing node; use for simple attribute changes like setting a status, priority, or due date. Only the provided fields will be changed. For content or structural changes, consider `naumu_delegate` instead - it understands the full graph context and can propagate updates to related nodes. Attribute keys AND values must match the schema for the node type; use naumu_get_schema to check valid attribute names, types, and values before updating. Date attributes accept either null (to clear), an ISO date string "YYYY-MM-DD" (single day), or { start: "YYYY-MM-DD", end?: "YYYY-MM-DD" } (inclusive range). Example: { "due_date": { "start": "2026-05-21", "end": "2026-05-23" } } or { "due_date": "2026-05-21" } or { "due_date": null }. Select attributes accept the value label as a string. Person attributes accept a member name, email or user id as a string (null clears); a person attribute with `multiple: true` in the schema takes an array of them. The server resolves them against the space members and rejects anyone who is not a member - use naumu_list_members to see who is.

attributes.description: Schema-defined attributes to set. Examples: {"Status": "In Progress"}, {"due_date": {"start": "2026-05-21", "end": "2026-05-23"}}, {"due_date": "2026-05-21"}, {"due_date": null}.

name: naumu_update_node
title: Update Node
